blocks.en: Improving Air Pollution Prevention and Control

blocks.zh: 完成5亿吨水泥熟料产能、1亿吨焦化产能超低排放改造。加快更新国四及以下货车和国二及以下工程机械，推进老旧营运船舶报废更新。以京津冀及周边地区为重点，逐步淘汰65蒸吨/小时及以下的工业燃煤锅炉，推动6000万标砖/年以下烧结砖生产线整合退出、燃煤电厂完成全负荷脱硝改造，开展产业集群大气污染综合治理。
blocks.en: Ultra-low emission upgrading will be completed for 500 million tonnes of cement clinker capacity and 100 million tonnes of coking capacity. The replacement of China IV and below trucks and China II and below construction machinery will be accelerated, and old operating ships will be scrapped and replaced. Focusing on the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and surrounding areas, industrial coal-fired boilers of 65 steam tonnes per hour and below will be phased out, sintered brick production lines below 60 million standard bricks per year will be consolidated and withdrawn, coal-fired power plants will complete full-load denitration upgrading, and comprehensive air pollution control will be carried out in industrial clusters.

blocks.zh: 水资源、水环境、水生态统筹治理
blocks.en: Coordinated Governance of Water Resources, Water Environment and Water Ecology

blocks.zh: 以长江、黄河、珠江、淮河、松花江等流域为重点，开展总磷浓度超标断面整治和水生态综合治理。实施国控入海河流总氮治理与管控，推进饮用水水源地规范化建设。统筹开展太湖、丹江口库区、巢湖、洱海、白洋淀、乌梁素海、洪湖等30个重点湖库生态保护治理，加强大运河保护治理。推进城镇生活污水收集处理设施建设改造。实施京津冀、黄河流域再生水利用工程。
blocks.en: Focusing on the Yangtze, Yellow, Pearl, Huai and Songhua river basins, sections where total phosphorus concentrations exceed standards will be remediated and comprehensive water ecology governance will be carried out. Total nitrogen treatment and control will be implemented for state-controlled rivers entering the sea, and standardized development of drinking water sources will be advanced. Ecological protection and governance will be carried out in a coordinated way for 30 key lakes and reservoirs, including Taihu Lake, the Danjiangkou Reservoir area, Chaohu Lake, Erhai Lake, Baiyangdian Lake, Ulansuhai Lake and Honghu Lake, and protection and governance of the Grand Canal will be strengthened. The construction and upgrading of urban domestic sewage collection and treatment facilities will be advanced. Reclaimed water utilization projects will be implemented in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and the Yellow River basin.

blocks.zh: 土壤污染源头防控和治理
blocks.en: Source Control and Treatment of Soil Pollution

blocks.zh: 聚焦石化、化工等行业，实施土壤污染源头防控项目。开展重点县农用地土壤重金属溯源整治。实施长江沿线1公里化工腾退地块土壤污染专项治理工程。
blocks.en: Focusing on industries such as petrochemicals and chemicals, projects for source control of soil pollution will be implemented. Tracing and remediation of heavy metals in agricultural land soil in key counties will be carried out. A special project for treating soil pollution on chemical industry sites vacated within 1 kilometer along the Yangtze River will be implemented.

blocks.zh: 推进长江流域磷石膏库环境风险隐患排查治理。建设改造建筑垃圾收集、临时贮存、资源化利用、处置等设施。升级改造城市生活垃圾分类投放及收集转运设施，垃圾清运能力达到75万吨/日。
blocks.en: Investigation and treatment of environmental risks at phosphogypsum storage sites in the Yangtze River basin will be advanced. Facilities for the collection, temporary storage, resource utilization and disposal of construction waste will be built and upgraded. Facilities for the classified drop-off and collection and transfer of urban household waste will be upgraded, and waste removal capacity will reach 750,000 tonnes per day.

blocks.zh: 推动未达标危险废物填埋场改造提升，对退役危险废物填埋场进行封场综合治理。开展丹江口库区及上游等尾矿库污染区域系统治理，实施一批历史遗留重金属矿区环境安全隐患整治项目。
blocks.en: Hazardous waste landfills that do not meet standards will be upgraded, and decommissioned hazardous waste landfills will undergo comprehensive closure and treatment. Systematic treatment of pollution around tailings ponds in the Danjiangkou Reservoir area and its upstream will be carried out, and a number of projects to remediate environmental safety hazards in legacy heavy metal mining areas will be implemented.

blocks.zh: 在工业废水、城镇污水、畜禽养殖等领域实施一批新污染物协同治理示范项目。实施新污染物协同监测和危害评估，提升新污染物发现、跟踪和应对水平。布局建设国家和流域性新污染物治理技术中心。
blocks.en: A number of demonstration projects for the coordinated treatment of emerging pollutants will be implemented in fields such as industrial wastewater, urban sewage and livestock and poultry farming. Coordinated monitoring and hazard assessment of emerging pollutants will be carried out, and the capacity to detect, track and respond to emerging pollutants will be improved. National and river-basin technical centers for the treatment of emerging pollutants will be established.
